senses.definition: The fragrant flower of a tropical tree (Cananga odorata) native to southeast Asia.
An essential oil derived from this flower used in aromatherapy and perfumes.
senses.example: Essential oils such as jasmine, rose, vetiver, ilang-ilang, iris, vanilla, sandalwood or lavender cannot be synthesised in the laboratory.

senses.definition: The tree (Cananga odorata) on which ylang ylang flowers grow.
